verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents international Transfers and Batch Transfers to suppliers/employees/beneficiaries across countries and currencies, backed by interbank FX rates and transparent/guaranteed conversion rates, plus multi-currency global accounts and no-FX-fee cards — directly matching the finance-lead story of sending international payments in local currencies with transparent fees. Missing for 10: no independent/third-party fee-transparency audit or customer testimonial confirming real-world fee clarity beyond vendor docs.
